title: Notification connectors
intro: Channels where the meetings of this workspace can post: a team room, a chat channel, an inbox, your own service. Each meeting then picks what to send there, in its settings.
name: Name

fields.token: Access token of the posting account

help.email: Sends through the mail server of this instance (SMTP_URL). Each meeting chooses who receives the messages: its participants or its hosts.
help.matrix: Posts with a Matrix account, ideally a service account invited to the rooms. Token: account settings › Help & About › Advanced; it stays valid as long as that session is not signed out. Messages are sent unencrypted.
help.slack: Create an incoming webhook for the channel (Slack app › Incoming Webhooks) and paste its address.
help.teams: In the Teams channel, add the “Post to a channel when a webhook request is received” workflow and paste its address.
help.discord: Channel settings › Integrations › Webhooks › New webhook, then copy its address.
help.mattermost: Integrations › Incoming webhooks › Add, then paste its address.
help.webhook: Ronde sends a signed JSON POST for each event (headers X-Ronde-Event, X-Ronde-Delivery, X-Ronde-Timestamp, X-Ronde-Signature).
help.sms: Sends text messages through Twilio to the mobile numbers of the people, as entered in their profile. Account SID and auth token: Twilio console › Account info.
help.whatsapp: Sends WhatsApp messages through Twilio to the mobile numbers of the people. The sender must be a WhatsApp sender approved in Twilio; outside a conversation the person started, WhatsApp may require an approved template.

secretKept: Saved and hidden. Leave empty to keep it.
signingKeyGenerated: Leave empty to have one generated.
signingKeyOnce: Signing key of the webhook. Copy it now: it will not be shown again.
signingKeyHelp: X-Ronde-Signature is “sha256=” followed by the hex HMAC-SHA256, with this key, of the X-Ronde-Timestamp value, a dot, then the body.
usedBy: {count, plural, =0 {Not used yet} one {Used by # notification} other {Used by # notifications}}
testSentEmail: Test email sent to your address.
noSecretKey: The server has no encryption key (SECRET_KEY): only email connectors can be added. Set SECRET_KEY to store tokens and webhook addresses.
fromHint: In international form, as bought or approved in Twilio.
testSentPhone: Test message sent to your mobile number.
